query:
SELECT (SELECT md5(coalesce(string_agg(oracle_id::text || read_hash || coalesce(source, '') || oracle_matches::text || coalesce(proof::text, '') || differs::text, ',' ORDER BY oracle_id), ''))
                       FROM card_drafts WHERE NOT retired) AS "current!",
                      (SELECT count(*) FROM card_reads) AS "reads!",
                      (SELECT max(id) FROM card_reads) AS last_read
